name: socless
description: Live schematic view of Chisel designs, linked to the source.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: SoCLess runs your build (Mill) and tests, which requires a trusted workspace.

socless.javaPath.description: Java 21+ executable that runs the SoCLess language server. Empty: $JAVA_HOME/bin/java, else java on the PATH.

socless.serverJar.description: SoCLess language server jar. Empty: the one bundled with the extension.

socless.waveFlag.description: ChiselSim option that turns waveforms on for Simulate, passed to ScalaTest as -D<flag>=1 (emitVcd is ChiselSim's; a project may define its own, such as emitFst).

socless.surferCommand.description: Waveform viewer that Simulate starts on the trace (an executable, run as <command> <trace>).
